item.title: Full professor: Selection procedure by call for Full professors (professori di I fascia). 2026_PRO_DMEC_2 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-02 Meccanica applicata alle macchine

In line with the activities of the Mechanical Systems section, the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Politecnico di Milano is seeking a tenured full professor with proven scientific expertise in the methods and tools of Applied Mechanics and Systems Dynamics and Control, as to strengthen its research areas related to the study of the aerodynamics of rail and road vehicles and its implications for operational safety, as well as fluid-structure interactions in buildings, and the monitoring and diagnostics of rail vehicles including with the support of AI by developing energy harvesting systems and appropriately designed sensors.
